question.en: Which fruit naturally floats on water?
question.ms: Buah manakah secara semula jadi boleh terapung di atas air?

funFact.en: Apples are about 25% air, which is why they float in water.
funFact.ms: Epal mengandungi kira-kira 25% udara, sebab itulah ia boleh terapung di dalam air.

question.en: Which planet in our solar system can have rain made of diamonds?
question.ms: Planet manakah dalam sistem suria yang boleh mengalami hujan berlian?

funFact.en: Scientists believe extreme pressure in Neptune’s atmosphere can turn carbon into falling diamonds.
funFact.ms: Saintis percaya tekanan ekstrem di atmosfera Neptun boleh menukarkan karbon menjadi berlian yang jatuh seperti hujan.

question.en: Which animal has fingerprints almost identical to humans?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai cap jari hampir sama seperti manusia?

funFact.en: Koala fingerprints are so similar to humans that they can sometimes confuse forensic investigators.
funFact.ms: Cap jari koala sangat serupa dengan manusia sehingga kadangkala boleh mengelirukan penyiasat forensik.

question.en: Which country has more lakes than the rest of the world combined?
question.ms: Negara manakah mempunyai lebih banyak tasik daripada gabungan seluruh dunia?

funFact.en: Canada has over 2 million lakes, containing about 20% of the world’s freshwater.
funFact.ms: Kanada mempunyai lebih 2 juta tasik yang mengandungi kira-kira 20% air tawar dunia.

question.en: Which animal’s heart is located in its head?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang jantungnya terletak di kepalanya?

funFact.en: A shrimp’s heart is located in its head area because its brain and organs are grouped there.
funFact.ms: Jantung udang terletak di bahagian kepalanya kerana otak dan organ pentingnya berkumpul di kawasan itu.

question.en: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
question.ms: Logam manakah yang berbentuk cecair pada suhu bilik?

funFact.en: Mercury melts at about −39°C, so it stays liquid at normal room temperatures.
funFact.ms: Merkuri mencair pada kira-kira −39°C, jadi ia kekal cecair pada suhu bilik biasa.

question.en: Which sea creature has teeth in its stomach?
question.ms: Makhluk laut manakah mempunyai gigi di dalam perutnya?

funFact.en: Crabs grind food using stomach structures called gastric mills that act like teeth.
funFact.ms: Ketam mengisar makanan menggunakan struktur perut dipanggil gastric mill yang berfungsi seperti gigi.

question.en: Which gas makes up most of Earth’s atmosphere?
question.ms: Gas manakah yang membentuk sebahagian besar atmosfera Bumi?

funFact.en: About 78% of Earth’s atmosphere is nitrogen, while oxygen makes up about 21%.
funFact.ms: Kira-kira 78% atmosfera Bumi terdiri daripada nitrogen, manakala oksigen sekitar 21%.

question.en: Which part of the human body contains no blood vessels?
question.ms: Bahagian tubuh manusia manakah yang tidak mempunyai salur darah?

funFact.en: The cornea gets oxygen directly from the air instead of through blood vessels.
funFact.ms: Kornea mendapat oksigen terus dari udara dan bukannya melalui salur darah.

question.en: Which country spans 11 time zones, the most in the world?
question.ms: Negara manakah merentasi 11 zon waktu, paling banyak di dunia?

funFact.en: Russia stretches across Europe and Asia and uses 11 different time zones.
funFact.ms: Rusia merentasi Eropah dan Asia serta menggunakan 11 zon waktu berbeza.

question.en: Which country has a town where residents live inside underground homes to escape extreme heat?
question.ms: Negara manakah mempunyai bandar di mana penduduk tinggal di rumah bawah tanah untuk mengelakkan haba melampau?

funFact.en: In Coober Pedy, Australia, many homes are built underground to stay cool in desert temperatures.
funFact.ms: Di Coober Pedy, Australia, banyak rumah dibina di bawah tanah untuk kekal sejuk dalam suhu gurun.

question.en: Which animal can survive being frozen and come back to life when thawed?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup semula selepas dibekukan dan dicairkan?

funFact.en: Wood frogs can survive freezing by producing chemicals that protect their cells.
funFact.ms: Katak kayu boleh bertahan beku dengan menghasilkan bahan kimia yang melindungi sel mereka.

question.en: Which desert is technically the largest desert on Earth?
question.ms: Gurun manakah sebenarnya gurun terbesar di Bumi?

funFact.en: Antarctica is classified as a desert because it receives very little precipitation.
funFact.ms: Antartika diklasifikasikan sebagai gurun kerana menerima hujan yang sangat sedikit.

question.en: Which animal can hold its breath the longest among mammals?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh menahan nafas paling lama dalam kalangan mamalia?

funFact.en: Cuvier’s beaked whales have been recorded holding their breath for over 3 hours.
funFact.ms: Paus berparuh Cuvier pernah direkodkan menahan nafas lebih daripada 3 jam.

question.en: Which tree species can communicate with other trees through underground fungal networks?
question.ms: Spesies pokok manakah boleh berkomunikasi dengan pokok lain melalui rangkaian kulat bawah tanah?

funFact.en: Trees like Douglas fir share nutrients and signals through fungal networks known as the 'Wood Wide Web.'
funFact.ms: Pokok seperti Douglas fir berkongsi nutrien dan isyarat melalui rangkaian kulat yang dikenali sebagai 'Wood Wide Web'.
